title: Checkers
description: Play the classic game of checkers against a friend on another device, or against the computer. Jumps are compulsory, kings move both ways, and the last player with pieces wins.
how_to: Tap a piece, then tap a highlighted square to move
Move diagonally forward; jump an opponent to capture it
If a jump is available you must take it
Reach the far row to crown a King that moves both ways
